text:
Avery L.: Hi folks — my spouse just accepted a new job and their employer benefits start next month. Can I remove them from our medical midyear?
Lina (People Ops): Congrats to them! Yes, gain of other coverage is a qualifying life event. We need documentation from the spouse's employer showing coverage start date or a benefits enrollment confirmation.
Avery L.: What exactly should that doc show? An offer letter or benefits ID card?
Benefits Admin: Preferred: employer benefits confirmation showing employee name, plan type, and effective date. A benefits enrollment confirmation email or an insurance card with effective date is fine. An offer letter that only mentions eligibility without effective date is usually not enough.
Avery L.: I have an email from their HR confirming benefits effective 2026-06-01 and plan details. Is that acceptable?
Lina (People Ops): Yes that works. Upload it using the secure link and choose "QLE - removal (gain of other coverage)". Put the spouse's name and the date coverage begins in the notes.
Avery L.: Will coverage end on the spouse's new coverage start date or the date I request? Need to know for an upcoming appointment.
Ken L.: We can request the termination effective the spouse's new coverage start date (carrier usually accepts that). If you want coverage to end sooner, carriers may not allow earlier terminations retroactively. We'll submit termination to the carrier with the effective date you provide and confirm once accepted. Payroll will adjust premiums/proration accordingly.
Avery L.: Is there any impact to my benefits (like losing family tier) immediately?
Lina (People Ops): Removing a dependent will change your tier and monthly premium. You can also switch plans during the QLE flow if you want to move to single coverage or change elections, depending on the QLE rules. Use the portal flow after you upload docs.
Avery L.: Secure upload?
people-ops-bot: Secure upload link: https://benefits.redwood.com/secure-upload/AL-1912345678 (expires in 14 days).
Avery L.: Uploaded the HR email and a screenshot of the new ID card.
people-ops-bot: Case created: PO-8210 - Spouse removal due to gain of other coverage. Benefits admin notified.
Benefits Admin: Got the docs. We'll submit to the carrier today and DM when termination is processed. Expect confirmation within 2 business days.
Avery L.: Thanks everyone — appreciate the fast help.
